## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do that rustsheng doesn't support today?

## Proposed solution

Describe the command, option, or behavior you'd like.

## Protocol / hardware notes

If this involves the radio protocol, link any reference (k5prog, k5prog-win,
K5TOOL, uv-k5-firmware) or captured datagrams (`sniffer` / `-vvv`) that document
it. Note which radio revision / bootloader it targets.

## Alternatives considered

Anything you've already tried or other approaches.
